title: Oleshky Truce Enters Third Day As Humanitarian Hopes Collide With Russia Deportation Fears
content: A fragile cease-fire around Russian-occupied Oleshky entered its third day on October 29, offering hope to thousands of civilians facing severe shortages and perilous escape routes, amid fears that Russia could use the pause to forcibly transfer residents to Russia or occupied Crimea.

title: 'Life On Every Street': Ukrainians In Kherson Welcome Cease-Fire In Nearby Oleshky
content: A US-brokered cease-fire went into effect on October 27 to let aid arrive in the Russian-occupied suburb of Oleshky and allow civilians to leave. On the opposite side of the Dnieper River, in the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, locals said the pause in fighting produced a rare sense of normalcy.

title: How Russia Is Teaching Children To Fly Military Drones
content: Russia wants a million drone operators by 2030 and schools are adapting fast to fill the quota. The authorities are using games and competitions to draw millions of young people into the field.
